data.name: Msg_RsaRequired
data.value:
Key-only login requires an RSA public key.
RSA is the only key type verified to authenticate on this firmware's dropbear, so a key-only build with another type could leave the device with no way to log in. Use an RSA key, or untick “Disable” and set a root password as a fallback.
